6bc8f6928136857afc21813e6ed5c27427f3d106.summary: Genians Security Center describes Operation ToyBox Story, a March 2025 spear phishing campaign attributed to the APT37 group, linked to North Korea, targeting activists focused on North Korea. Lures impersonated a South Korean national security think tank event, and malicious LNK files in ZIP archives delivered the RoKRAT malware. RoKRAT used cloud services including Dropbox, pCloud and Yandex as command-and-control. The report links some accounts to Russian Yandex services, hedges some findings, and says the investigation is ongoing.

6bb03bec5028bfed56fd30d98d866fb166150e9f.summary: Gemini Advisory reports that FIN7, a cybercrime group known for point-of-sale card theft and later ransomware activity, is running a fake cybersecurity firm, Bastion Secure, to recruit unwitting IT specialists. A source hired through the firm was given tools that Gemini matched to the Carbanak and Lizar/Tirion post-exploitation toolkits, previously attributed to FIN7. The firm's website was largely copied from a legitimate company, and several listed addresses were checked and did not match the firm. Gemini assesses the link with high confidence; FIN7's exact role in ransomware is unclear.
